title: Singularities of Non-negative Matrix Factorization and their application to Bayesian inference
summary: Non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) is a singular statistical model whose Bayesian asymptotics are governed by the real log canonical threshold (RLCT). We study the local geometry of the factorization map and derive an upper bound for the RLCT of NMF. Let $H$ be the model inner dimension and $H_0$ the non-negative rank of the true $M\times N$ matrix. Assuming that the true matrix admits a strictly positive factorization of inner dimension $H_0$ in the interior of the parameter domain, we prove, for smooth positive priors, that $λ\leq \{(H-H_0)\min(M,N)+H_0(M+N-H_0)\}/2$.
